annotations.title: Generate a tracked short-link QR code

description: Generate a dynamic, click-tracked SVG QR code for a short link (/l/<code>), styled with the saved brand colours or high-contrast black on white for counter signs, menus and flyers. Because the QR points to /l/<code>, the user can update the destination URL later with short_links_save without reprinting the sign. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A short link id from short_links_list or short_links_save.

size.description: Output SVG width and height in pixels, from 128 to 1024. Defaults to 512.

useBrandColors.description: true styles the QR code with the saved brand colours (default); false returns high-contrast black on white for printing.

name: short_links_qr
title: Generate a tracked short-link QR code
